problem_statement: RIOT's build system must support an EXTERNAL_PKG_DIRS make variable that lists directories containing packages outside the RIOT tree. When a package is requested through USEPKG or through Kconfig, its Makefile and Kconfig files must be found in those directories, just as EXTERNAL_MODULE_DIRS already works for modules. In particular, Kconfig options defined in an external package's Kconfig file must become available so that application configuration can enable the package and the generated configuration can contain the corresponding CONFIG_PACKAGE_* and CONFIG_KCONFIG_EXTERNAL_PKG_* options. Today EXTERNAL_PKG_DIRS is not recognised, so external packages cannot be built or selected through Kconfig.
